ModMetaData.name: Construction Pipeline Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Helps construction-heavy colonies run more smoothly, especially when many blueprints are queued or terrain-building mods such as Tilled Soil are active.
CPO reduces repeated behind-the-scenes checks while pawns are building and lets them continue eligible zero-cost terrain work without an unnecessary job-search step. Vanilla work priorities, material delivery, pathfinding, construction speed, success chance, and final construction safety checks remain in control.
Requires Harmony. No settings and no save data. Normally safe to add or remove between sessions; keep a normal save backup when changing a large mod list.
RimWorld 1.6 Multiplayer is supported. Every player must use the same CPO version and mod list.
Do not enable this with Construction Queue Optimizer; the legacy mod contains the same construction patches.
